The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.en:
The probe type. Valid values:

- **host_probe**: host probe

- **vpc\_black\_hole_probe**: VPC blackhole probe.

title.zh: 根据探针类型和节点编号查询探针编号
title.en: Query probe iDs by probe type and node ID

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-honeypot-probe-uuid --control-node-id a882e590-b87b-45a6-87b9-d0a3e5a00000 --probe-type host_probe --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListHoneypotProbeUuid --region cn-hangzhou --ProbeType host_probe --ControlNodeId 'a882e590-b87b-45a6-87b9-d0a3e5a00000' --Lang zh
